name: GUI: wire multi-file `import` resolution via compile_project + project_root

task_definition.title: GUI: wire multi-file `import` resolution via compile_project + project_root
task_definition.description: EngineSession in the GUI compiles a single .ri file via compile_with_stdlib, which never invokes ModuleResolver. As a result, user `import foo` declarations in the GUI silently fail to load sibling .ri modules — the imported module's pub items are absent from the engine, and instantiations of imported types yield empty engine state with no surfaced error. Wire the GUI engine to use module_dag::compile_project with project_root = entry_path.parent() (and the configured stdlib_root) so multi-file user projects work the same way they already do in tests and the LSP's goto-def.
